label: AbiZ system
definition: An abortive infection system in which an organism possesses an abiZ locus encoding a membrane-associated lactococcal phage-resistance determinant that accelerates infected-cell lysis through AbiZ-enhanced holin/lysin activity and restricts P335 phage propagation.
observations: AbiZ branch under abortive infection system; distinct from individual abiZ genes, AbiZ proteins, the pTRK914 experimental plasmid, AbiA or LlaI defenses coencoded on pTR2030, holin/lysin lysis without AbiZ, AbiZ escape phages, ToxIN systems, AbiQ systems, AbiE systems, generic abortive infection systems, and source database rows naming one Abi locus.
